prompt:
A desktop website home page, rendered edge to edge at 16:9 with crisp readable text, no browser window or device. The references are style inspiration adapted into a real working portfolio; do not copy their layout or content.

It is the portfolio of Giannia, an architecture student. Architecture firms and admissions committees come to scan her works and open one.

What leads: a catalog of her works as cut-paper stickers on the sheet, each sticker cut in the silhouette of its project (a bathhouse roofline, an arched library window, a stair, a pavilion umbrella roof, a folded page for an essay) and holding a small crisp drawing or model photo inside. Each sticker has a small typeset caption: "Bathhouse on the Canal · Studio III · 2025", "Threshold Library · Studio II · 2024", "On Thresholds · essay · 2024", "Pavilion for Rain · competition · 2023". A crayon ring is scrawled around the one being hovered.

Frame: top left "Giannia" in marker lettering with "works & words" small beneath; a row of cut-paper filter chips: All, Studio projects, Models, Sketches, Writing, Competitions; top right "About" and "Contact"; small credit line at the bottom: "placeholder works".
